title: HERALD: High-Fidelity Exemplar Retrieval with Adaptive Landmark Distillation for Heterophily-Aware Graph Condensation
abstract: arXiv:2609.11123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph condensation aims to produce a small surrogate graph that preserves the downstream node-classification performance of a much larger original graph. Existing methods rely on Weisfeiler-Lehman neighbourhood aggregation or gradient-based distribution matching, both of which assume that adjacent nodes share the same label, an assumption that breaks down under heterophily. We propose HERALD (High-fidelity Exemplar Retrieval with Adaptive Landmark Distillation), a gradient-free graph condensation framework that adapts the node scoring and feature selection in the condensation pipeline to the graph's measured heterophily. translated_title: HERALD：面向异质性感知图压缩的高保真样本检索与自适应地标蒸馏
translated_abstract: 图压缩旨在生成一个小型代理图，使其能够保持远大于其规模的原始图在下游节点分类任务中的性能。现有方法依赖于Weisfeiler-Lehman邻域聚合或基于梯度的分布匹配，这两种方法都假设相邻节点共享相同的标签，而这一假设在异质性图上会失效。我们提出了HERALD（高保真样本检索与自适应地标蒸馏），这是一个无梯度的图压缩框架，它使压缩流程中的节点评分和特征选择能够适应图的实测异质性。HERALD通过联合Fisher判别性和激活密度准则来选择特征，该准则在异质图上降低聚合表示的权重；同时通过原型代表性、决策边界接近度和局部内在维数（LID）的加权组合来对节点进行评分，其中权重……
tldr: 提出了HERALD，一个无需梯度的图压缩框架，通过结合Fisher判别性与激活密度的特征选择准则，以及融合原型代表性、决策边界接近度和局部内在维数的节点评分机制，使图压缩过程能够自适应地感知图的异质性，从而在异质图上实现高保真的下游分类性能。
en_tdlr: HERALD is a gradient-free graph condensation framework that adapts to graph heterophily by selecting features via a joint Fisher-discriminability and activation-density criterion and scoring nodes through a weighted combination of prototype representativeness, decision-boundary proximity, and Local Intrinsic Dimensionality.
